thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: CRITICAL: Tenant 'ivy-labs' dedicated pool experiencing spike in tail latency and request queuing. 90th+ p99s > 3s, error rate 1.8%. Auto-scaler reports sustained queue growth. Paging on-call.
jules: ack. paging in. oncall here, starting triage. any recent deploys in that pool?

mira: not from infra side, no deploys in the last 2h. I see a bunch of long requests from IvyLabs with big prompt sizes — avg tokens_in ~1400, model variant = redwood-7b-q4. Could be batching mismatch + their spike.

alex: saw the same. Scheduler backlog RT shows tenant-specific queue length climbed from 4 -> 48 in 6m. tail latency correlates with max_batch_tokens sometimes — they have bespoke profile.

jules: assign mitigation: 1) temporarily reduce ivy-labs max_batch_tokens 2) enable shard-level shaper for their tenant to smooth bursts 3) add temporary weight cap to prevent blocking other tenants. I'll do a quick config tweak, then we can observe.

leo: looping in support to notify customer (FYI only).

mira: posting current metric snapshot:
```
tenant: ivy-labs
pool: dedicated-us-west-2-2
requests/s: 18 -> 120 spike
avg tokens_in: 1.4k
p95 latency: 2.9s
p99 latency: 4.2s
queue depth: 48
errors (5xx): 22 (1.8%)
```

jules: running the safe knob set. command: `redwoodctl tenant update --tenant ivy-labs --set max_batch_tokens=96 --set scheduler.shaper=burst-smoother --set tenant.weight_cap=0.2`

mira: copy. I'll run the change for validation and post logs.

mira: applied. here's the rollout log:
```
[2026-07-09T14:25:03Z] apply tenant config ivy-labs {max_batch_tokens:96, scheduler:burst-smoother, weight_cap:0.2}
[2026-07-09T14:25:03Z] pushing config to pool dedicated-us-west-2-2
[2026-07-09T14:25:05Z] ack from node-gpu-12
[2026-07-09T14:25:06Z] ack from node-gpu-15
[2026-07-09T14:25:08Z] config converge complete
```

ajex: (typo) alex: after change, queue dropped to 12 in ~30s, p95 improved to 1.1s, p99 -> 1.9s. error rate trending down. Looks promising.

jules: nice. can we also enable prefix/KV caching for ivy-labs for this pool? their requests have repeated system prompts.

mira: KV cache is already on for the model, but we can preseed prefix cache for the tenant to reduce repeated token work. doing that now.

mira: preseed job launched with small TTL (10m) for safety. log:
```
[2026-07-09T14:26:12Z] prefix-cache: preseed tenant=ivy-labs, keys=3, ttl=600s
[2026-07-09T14:26:15Z] preseed complete, hits expected ~30% for next 10m
```

leo: pinged customer (Ivy eng) — they reported a surge from a user-driven experiment, appreciate the heads-up. They asked for ETA to steady state.

jules: we'll monitor for 20 mins and then follow up to confirm. If we re-see >40 queue depth, plan is to either move them to a dedicated isolated pool or apply more aggressive bespoke shaper (lower max_batch_tokens to 64 + token cap per request).

alex: quick note: reducing max_batch_tokens reduces throughput per GPU for long prompts but helps latency fairness. We're already seeing tradeoff but net impact is good since other tenants recovered.

mira: metrics at +5m post-change:
```
queue depth: 12 -> stable 8-14
requests/s: 85 -> 62
p95: 2.9s -> 1.05s
p99: 4.2s -> 1.8s
errors: 22 -> 3 (0.25%)
```

jules: good. setting a 2h watch and handing off to rotation (night-shift) for 04:00 UTC follow-up. I'll create a follow-up ticket and assign to eng-runtime.

mira: ticket created: RW-INC-4821 - "IvyLabs dedicated pool: bespoke batching surge, mitigated; follow-up: schedule/knob improvements & autoscaler rules". link: https://redwood/ops/tickets/RW-INC-4821

alex: recommendation for follow-up: add a tenant-specific autoscale threshold for ivy-labs (scale earlier on queue depth) + add automatic temporary shaper when avg tokens_in > 1k. plus an eval to ensure quality doesn't regress when we reduce max_batch_tokens.

jules: agree. I'll add those to the ticket. For now, moving thread to post-incident. oncall handover: night oncall @mira will keep watch until 04:00 UTC, then hand to rotation.

mira: ack. I'll leave a short runbook note in the ticket re: commands used:
```
# quick rollback/adjust commands
redwoodctl tenant get --tenant ivy-labs
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant ivy-labs --set max_batch_tokens=128
redwoodctl tenant update --tenant ivy-labs --set scheduler.shaper=default
```

jules: thanks team. closing pager, marking incident mitigated — keep an eye for recurrence. :white_check_mark: 

mira: leaving final metric snapshot at last check (14:40Z): p99=1.7s, queue=9, errors=1. All good.

leo: I've informed IvyLabs support contact and they'll throttle their experiment. they asked for a short post-incident note which I'll include on RW-INC-4821.

incident-bot: Incident RW-INC-4821 status -> mitigated, severity -> P2, pager closed.

jules: added follow-up: schedule a small tuning window with ivy-eng and runtime next week to define a stable bespoke profile (max_batch_tokens, autoscale thresholds, shaper settings).
